about_the_game:
A MEDIEVAL JOURNEY WITH A V8 TOUCH

Lead and fight in epic battlefields and arenas that will test your skills with traps and obstacles. Choose your class and triumph against your opponents with the car and weapons you've built yourself.

Immerse yourself in an original world with a Medievalpunk style and a high-fantasy story.

METAL ON METAL

The War of Wheels takes place in every corner of the realm in two modes: Field Battle and Gladiatorial Arena.

Moving through the vast open world you will often encounter brigands or knights from enemy factions and must face them in bloody team battles.

From the cities you can access the Arenas and face other knights in jousts full of traps, obstacles and unpredictable magic.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR VEHICLE

Choose the vehicle that best suits your play style and customize it according to your preferences. Each vehicle can equip different weapons and use unique abilities that will make you unstoppable in battle.

Don't give up on style, however! You'll be able to enhance your car's aesthetics with lots of unlockable items.

A KINGDOM IN YOUR HANDS

The Kingdom of Zeranthya and the Emperor have blessed knights with knowledge of technology and Aether, crystals that catalyze magic in the roaring engines of battle cars.

Forge ( or break) alliances with different Factions to secure the maximum Aether possible and move closer to victory in the War of Wheels.

GAME FEATURES

  • Fantasy classes: 6 car groups inspired by classic racing and fantasy classes from RPG games, each with unique gameplay and weapons.

  • Original settings: 4 unique biomes, from man-made villages to natural environments.

  • Unique customization: use different skins or colors, add decorations to create the perfect gladiatorial machine.

  • Unleash your fury: destructible arenas full of action and traps.

  • 4 guilds with their own stories and motivations.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Most modern 64bit Linux distributions
  • Processor: Dual-Core 2.4 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA 660 with latest proprietary drivers (not older than 6 months) / similar AMD with latest proprietary drivers (not older than 6 months; the minimum supported resolution for the game is 720p) with Vulkan support.
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA 660 with latest proprietary drivers (not older than 6 months) / similar AMD with latest proprietary drivers (not older than 6 months; the minimum supported resolution for the game is 720p) with Vulkan support.
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM

  • DirectX: Version 11

  • Sound Card: DirectX®-compatible

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows® 10 64-bit/ Windows® 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or Ryzen 5 3600 and higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce 1060 or Radeon RX 570 and higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX®-compatible

short_description: Choose your class vehicle, customize it with deadly weapons and conquer your place in the world. War of Wheels is a frenetic car fighting game in an original “medievalpunk” setting. Ride your iron steed and become a legend.
